name: Protopasta Magnetic Iron PLA @base
filament_notes:
Iron-filled PLA (45% iron by weight). FAQ: 185-195C, about 10C cooler than standard PLA. Material Data Table: 200C up to 24 mm3/s, 55C plate; avoid printing below 3 mm3/s; hard steel nozzle and gears recommended. TDS: 192C, 60C bed. This profile uses 190C with a 24 mm3/s cap - move toward 200C when printing near the cap.
If parts warp, Proto-Pasta suggests turning the fan off and printing slower. Ferromagnetic (sticks to magnets, but isn't a magnet). Can be rusted for an aged finish. More brittle than PLA as filament; about 100 m per 500 g.
